_prompt:
You are deciding whether a known bug is present in a build, from the defects two judges confirmed by probing it. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: HEAD responses served through http.ServeContent (or with no Content-Length) get a strong ETag computed from the empty body.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

CONFIRMED DEFECTS:
- judge 1: Minor: a HEAD with no written body (ServeContent) gets no ETag, so a conditional HEAD returns 200 (probe schead=200, no ETag)
- judge 1: Minor: write errors ignored when the buffer is flushed
- judge 2: A HEAD response with no body (including ServeContent HEAD) gets no ETag, so it differs from GET. This is a documented, deliberate trade-off.
- judge 2: On a 304 it removes only Content-Length and keeps Content-Type (probe: the ServeContent 304 had ct=text/plain), while net/http drops it.
- judge 2: Write errors in startStreaming and finish are ignored.

Reply exactly: {"present": "yes"|"no", "quote": "<verbatim quote of the matching defect, or empty>"}
